children: Shein's trading debut hasn't been a roaring success. Keeping customers will be the next challenge, says eToro's Josh Gilbert. Shein's reach is unquestionable, but a big part of that brand loyalty comes down to price tags, and what customers love the most is getting hardest to protect as the era of cheap cross-border shipping comes to an end, Gilbert says. Shein's daily active users in Europe have fallen around 45% since the EU scrapped its duty exemption on small parcels. For Shein to grow into its valuation, supply chain has to become a second product, rented out to other brands through the marketplace and via deals. With almost $15 billion cash, Shein can afford to do that, the analyst says. (fabiana.negrinochoa@wsj.com)
